We need propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to output JSON route with reactions and template IDs. We need to find appropriate templates. Likely steps: 1) disconnection of amide bond between C(=O)N and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So retrosynthesis: break amide to carboxylic acid (alpha,beta-unsaturated acid) and aniline. 2) disconnect the alkene formation via Doebner modification: break C=C and carboxylic acid to aldehyde and malonic acid? Actually forward Doebner: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated acid. So retro: break the unsaturated acid into aldehyde (aryl aldehyde) and malonic acid. The unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl group? Wait structure: ...c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2. So the unsaturated acid is attached to phenyl sulfonyl via para position? Actually the sulfonyl attached to first phenyl (methyl phenyl). The unsaturated acid is attached to second phenyl (c2...). So step 2: break the C=C and C=O to give aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl with sulfonyl?) Wait the aldehyde would be on the phenyl ring that currently bears the unsaturated chain. So the aldehyde is p-? The chain is attached at para position of phenyl sulfonyl? Actually the sulfonyl attaches to first phenyl (methyl phenyl). The second phenyl (c2) is attached to sulfonyl and has the unsaturated chain. So the aldehyde precursor would be that phenyl with sulfonyl? The aldehyde would be p-? The aromatic aldehyde is the phenyl ring bearing the sulfonyl group? The sulfonyl is attached to that phenyl via N-SO2-? Wait sulfonamide: NS(=O)(=O)c2... So the sulfonamide nitrogen attached to first phenyl (methyl phenyl). The sulfonyl attached to second phenyl (c2...). So the unsaturated chain is attached to second phenyl (c2) at para position relative to sulfonyl? So the aldehyde precursor would be that phenyl with sulfonyl group and aldehyde substituent. So step 2: break unsaturated acid to aldehyde (aryl aldehyde with sulfonyl) + malonic acid.

3) sulfonamide formation: break N-S bond to give amine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride). So retro: target sulfonamide from p-toluidine and aryl sulfonyl chloride (the second phenyl sulfonyl chloride). So overall three steps: (1) amide formation, (2) Doebner modification, (3) sulfonamide formation.

We need template IDs. We don't know IDs; we can search. Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria for each transformation.

First, get functional groups list? Might not need. Let's search for amide formation (break C-N bond, form C=O and N). In forward direction, amide formation is C=O + N-H -> amide. So retro we break amide into carboxylic acid and amine. Use criteria: functional_groups_broken: "amide". functional_groups_formed: "carboxylic acid","amine". bonds_broken: "C-N". Let's try.



We will call search_template_catalog_by_criteria.
